hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ حَدَّثَنِي الشَّعْبِيُّ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَنَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ يَوْمَ نَزَلَ وَهِيَ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَشْيَاءَ مِنْ الْعِنَبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْعَسَلِ وَالْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالْخَمْرُ مَا خَامَرَ الْعَقْلَ وَثَلَاثٌ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يُفَارِقْنَا حَتَّى يَعْهَدَ إِلَيْنَا فِيهِنَّ عَهْدًا نَنْتَهِي إِلَيْهِ الْجَدُّ وَالْكَلَالَةُ وَأَبْوَابٌ مِنْ أَبْوَابِ الرِّبَا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Hanbal] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abu Hayyan] telah menceritakan kepadaku [Asy Sya'bi] dari [Ibnu Umar] dari [Umar] ia berkata, "Ketika pengharaman arak turun di hari pengharamannya, arak saat itu terbuat dari lima hal; anggur, kurma, madu, gandum, serta jewawut. Dan arak adalah sesuatu yang menutupi akal, dan ada tiga perkara yang aku inginkan Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam tidak meninggalkan kami hingga menjelaskan kepada kami mengenai ketiga perkara tersebut hingga kami memahaminya; (warisan) seorang kakek, orang yang tidak memiliki anak dan orang tua, serta beberapa bab mengenai riba."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Hanbal] narrated to us [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] narrated to us [Abu Hayyan] narrated to me [Asy Sya'bi] from [Ibnu Umar] from [Umar] he said, "When prohibition wine descended in day its prohibition, wine moment that made of from five thing; grapes, dates, honey, wheat, and millet. And wine is something who covering intellect, and there is three matters who I wanted The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him not left we until explained to we regarding third matters that until we understood it; (inheritance) a grandfather, person who not has child and person old, and beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Hanbal] 私たちに語った [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] 私たちに語った [Abu Hayyan] 私に語った [Asy Sya'bi] から [Ibnu Umar] から [Umar] 彼は言った, "〜のとき 禁止 酒 下りた 〜に 日 its 禁止, 酒 瞬間 その 作った の から 五 thing; ブドウ, ナツメヤシ, 蜂蜜, 小麦, そして キビ. そして 酒 である something 誰 覆うこと 理性, そして there である 三 事柄 誰 I 望んだ アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） 〜ない 去った we 〜まで explained へ we regarding 第三 事柄 その 〜まで we 理解した it; (inheritance) a grandfather, 人 誰 〜ない has 子 そして 人 古い, そして beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Hanbal] 우리에게 전했다 [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] 우리에게 전했다 [Abu Hayyan] 나에게 전했다 [Asy Sya'bi] 부터 [Ibnu Umar] 부터 [Umar] 그는 말했다, "~할 때 금지 술 내려왔다 에 날 its 금지, 술 순간 그 만들었다 의 부터 다섯 thing; 포도, 대추, 꿀, 밀, そして 기장. そして 술 이다 something 누구 덮음 이성, そして there 이다 셋 일들 누구 I 원했다 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) ~아니다 떠났다 we 까지 explained 에게 we regarding 셋째 일들 그 까지 we 이해했다 it; (inheritance) a grandfather, 사람 누구 ~아니다 has 자녀 そして 사람 오래된, そして beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Hanbal] 向我们讲述 [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] 向我们讲述 [Abu Hayyan] 向我讲述 [Asy Sya'bi] 从 [Ibnu Umar] 从 [Umar] 他说, "当 禁止 酒 下来 在 天 its 禁止, 酒 时刻 那 制作 的 从 五 thing; 葡萄, 椰枣, 蜂蜜, 小麦, 和 小米. 和 酒 是 something 谁 遮盖 理智, 和 there 是 三 事情 谁 I 想要 安拉的使者（愿他平安） 不 离开 we 直到 explained 向 we regarding 第三 事情 那 直到 we 理解 it; (inheritance) a grandfather, 人 谁 不 has 孩子 和 人 旧, 和 beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Hanbal] Nous a raconté [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] Nous a raconté [Abu Hayyan] M'a raconté [Asy Sya'bi] de [Ibnu Umar] de [Umar] il a dit, "quand interdiction vin est descendu dans jour its interdiction, vin moment que a fait de de cinq thing; raisins, dattes, miel, blé, et millet. et vin est something qui couverture raison, et there est trois affaires qui I a voulu Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui pas est parti we jusqu'à explained à we regarding troisième affaires que jusqu'à we a compris it; (inheritance) a grandfather, personne qui pas has enfant et personne ancien, et beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Hanbal] Hat uns erzählt [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] Hat uns erzählt [Abu Hayyan] Hat mir erzählt [Asy Sya'bi] von [Ibnu Umar] von [Umar] er sagte, "wenn Verbot Wein stieg herab in Tag its Verbot, Wein Moment dass machte von von fünf thing; Trauben, Datteln, Honig, Weizen, und Hirse. und Wein ist something wer Bedecken Verstand, und there ist drei Angelegenheiten wer I wollte Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm nicht verließ we bis explained zu we regarding dritter Angelegenheiten dass bis we verstand it; (inheritance) a grandfather, Person wer nicht has Kind und Person alt, und beberapa chapter regarding riba."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Hanbal] Ci ha narrato [Isma'il bin Ibrahim] Ci ha narrato [Abu Hayyan] Mi ha narrato [Asy Sya'bi] da [Ibnu Umar] da [Umar] disse, "quando divieto vino è sceso in giorno its divieto, vino momento che ha fatto di da cinque thing; uva, datteri, miele, grano, e miglio. e vino è something chi copertura intelletto, e there è tre questioni chi I ha voluto Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui non è partito we fino a explained a we regarding terzo questioni che fino a we ha capito it; (inheritance) a grandfather, persona chi non has figlio e persona vecchio, e beberapa chapter regarding riba."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْخُتَّلِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَقَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَلَمَّا نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ قَالَ عُمَرُ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ لَنَا فِي الْخَمْرِ بَيَانًا شِفَاءً فَنَزَلَتْ الْآيَةُ الَّتِي فِي الْبَقَرَةِ{ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنْ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِمَا إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ }الْآيَةَ قَالَ فَدُعِيَ عُمَرُ فَقُرِئَتْ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ لَنَا فِي الْخَمْرِ بَيَانًا شِفَاءً فَنَزَلَتْ الْآيَةُ الَّتِي فِي النِّسَاءِ{ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى }فَكَانَ مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا أُقِيمَتْ الصَّلَاةُ يُنَادِي أَلَا لَا يَقْرَبَنَّ الصَّلَاةَ سَكْرَانُ فَدُعِيَ عُمَرُ فَقُرِئَتْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ لَنَا فِي الْخَمْرِ بَيَانًا شِفَاءً فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ{ فَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ مُنْتَهُونَ }قَالَ عُمَرُ انْتَهَيْنَا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] telah mengabarkan kepada kami [Isma'il bin Ja'far] dari [Israil] dari [Abu Ishaq] dari ['Amru] dari [Umar bin Al Khathab] ia berkata, "Tatkala telah turun pengharaman arak Umar berkata, "Ya Allah, jelaskan kepada kami mengenai arak dengan penjelasan yang memuaskan." Kemudian turunlah ayat yang terdapat dalam Surat Al Baqarah (219): '(Mereka bertanya kepadamu tentang khamer dan judi…) '. 'Ammar berkata, "Kemudian Umar dipanggil dan dibacakan kepadanya ayat tersebut, ia berkata lagi, "Ya Allah, jelaskan kepada kami mengenai khamer dengan penjelasan yang memuaskan." Kemudian turunlah ayat yang terdapat pada Surat An Nisaa` (41): '(Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah kamu shalat, sedang kamu dalam keadaan mabuk…..) ' Penyeru Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam apabila shalat telah ditegakkan maka ia berseru, 'ketahuilah bahwa tidak boleh orang yang mabuk mendekati shalat! ' Kemudian Umar dipanggil dan dibacakanlah ayat tersebut kepadanya, lalu ia berkata, "Ya Allah jelaskanlah kepada kami mengenai khamer dengan penjelasan yang memuaskan!" Maka turunlah ayat ini: '(….. apakah kalian akan berhenti?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar berkata, "Kami telah berhenti."
hadits.en: Narrated to us ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] informed us [Isma'il bin Ja'far] from [Israil] from [Abu Ishaq] from ['Amru] from [Umar bin Al Khathab] he said, "When has descended prohibition wine Umar said, "O Allah, explain to we regarding wine with explanation who satisfying." Then was revealed verse who found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They asked to you regarding khamr and gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "Then Umar was called and was recited to him verse that, he said again, "O Allah, explain to we regarding khamr with explanation who satisfying." Then was revealed verse who found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O person-person who believed, do not you shalat, is you dalam condition intoxicated…..) ' Penyeru The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him when shalat has was established then he berseru, 'ketahuilah that not may person who intoxicated mendekati shalat! ' Then Umar was called and was recited verse that to him, then he said, "O Allah explain to we regarding khamr with explanation who satisfying!" Then was revealed verse this: '(….. whether you all will stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] 私たちに伝えた [Isma'il bin Ja'far] から [Israil] から [Abu Ishaq] から ['Amru] から [Umar bin Al Khathab] 彼は言った, "〜のとき has 下りた 禁止 酒 Umar said, "O Allah, explain へ we regarding 酒 とともに explanation 誰 satisfying." それから was revealed verse 誰 found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They 尋ねた へ you regarding ハムル そして gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "それから Umar 呼ばれた そして was recited へ him verse その, 彼は言った again, "O Allah, explain へ we regarding ハムル とともに explanation 誰 satisfying." それから was revealed verse 誰 found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O 人-人 誰 believed, do 〜ない you shalat, である you dalam 条件 酔った…..) ' Penyeru アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） 〜のとき shalat has was established それから he berseru, 'ketahuilah その 〜ない may 人 誰 酔った mendekati shalat! ' それから Umar 呼ばれた そして was recited verse その へ him, それから 彼は言った, "O Allah explain へ we regarding ハムル とともに explanation 誰 satisfying!" それから was revealed verse この: '(….. whether あなたがた 〜だろう stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] 우리에게 알려 주었다 [Isma'il bin Ja'far] 부터 [Israil] 부터 [Abu Ishaq] 부터 ['Amru] 부터 [Umar bin Al Khathab] 그는 말했다, "~할 때 has 내려왔다 금지 술 Umar said, "O Allah, explain 에게 we regarding 술 함께 explanation 누구 satisfying." 그러자 was revealed verse 누구 found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They 물었다 에게 you regarding 함르 そして gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "그러자 Umar 불렸다 そして was recited 에게 him verse 그, 그는 말했다 again, "O Allah, explain 에게 we regarding 함르 함께 explanation 누구 satisfying." 그러자 was revealed verse 누구 found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O 사람-사람 누구 believed, do ~아니다 you shalat, 이다 you dalam 조건 취한…..) ' Penyeru 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) ~할 때 shalat has was established 그러자 he berseru, 'ketahuilah 그 ~아니다 may 사람 누구 취한 mendekati shalat! ' 그러자 Umar 불렸다 そして was recited verse 그 에게 him, 그러자 그는 말했다, "O Allah explain 에게 we regarding 함르 함께 explanation 누구 satisfying!" 그러자 was revealed verse 이: '(….. whether 너희들 ~할 것이다 stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] 告诉我们 [Isma'il bin Ja'far] 从 [Israil] 从 [Abu Ishaq] 从 ['Amru] 从 [Umar bin Al Khathab] 他说, "当 has 下来 禁止 酒 Umar said, "O Allah, explain 向 we regarding 酒 与 explanation 谁 satisfying." 然后 was revealed verse 谁 found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They 问 向 you regarding 哈姆尔酒 和 gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "然后 Umar 被称为 和 was recited 向 him verse 那, 他说 again, "O Allah, explain 向 we regarding 哈姆尔酒 与 explanation 谁 satisfying." 然后 was revealed verse 谁 found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O 人-人 谁 believed, do 不 you shalat, 是 you dalam 条件 醉…..) ' Penyeru 安拉的使者（愿他平安） 当 shalat has was established 然后 he berseru, 'ketahuilah 那 不 may 人 谁 醉 mendekati shalat! ' 然后 Umar 被称为 和 was recited verse 那 向 him, 然后 他说, "O Allah explain 向 we regarding 哈姆尔酒 与 explanation 谁 satisfying!" 然后 was revealed verse 这: '(….. whether 你们 将 stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] Nous a informés [Isma'il bin Ja'far] de [Israil] de [Abu Ishaq] de ['Amru] de [Umar bin Al Khathab] il a dit, "quand has est descendu interdiction vin Umar said, "O Allah, explain à we regarding vin avec explanation qui satisfying." puis was revealed verse qui found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They a demandé à you regarding khamr et gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "puis Umar a été appelé et was recited à him verse que, il a dit again, "O Allah, explain à we regarding khamr avec explanation qui satisfying." puis was revealed verse qui found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O personne-personne qui believed, do pas you shalat, est you dalam condition ivre…..) ' Penyeru Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui quand shalat has was established puis he berseru, 'ketahuilah que pas may personne qui ivre mendekati shalat! ' puis Umar a été appelé et was recited verse que à him, puis il a dit, "O Allah explain à we regarding khamr avec explanation qui satisfying!" puis was revealed verse ce: '(….. whether vous tous va stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] Hat uns berichtet [Isma'il bin Ja'far] von [Israil] von [Abu Ishaq] von ['Amru] von [Umar bin Al Khathab] er sagte, "wenn has stieg herab Verbot Wein Umar said, "O Allah, explain zu we regarding Wein mit explanation wer satisfying." dann was revealed verse wer found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They fragte zu you regarding Khamr und gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "dann Umar wurde genannt und was recited zu him verse dass, er sagte again, "O Allah, explain zu we regarding Khamr mit explanation wer satisfying." dann was revealed verse wer found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O Person-Person wer believed, do nicht you shalat, ist you dalam Bedingung berauscht…..) ' Penyeru Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm wenn shalat has was established dann he berseru, 'ketahuilah dass nicht may Person wer berauscht mendekati shalat! ' dann Umar wurde genannt und was recited verse dass zu him, dann er sagte, "O Allah explain zu we regarding Khamr mit explanation wer satisfying!" dann was revealed verse dies: '(….. whether ihr alle wird stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato ['Abbad bin Musa Al Khuttali] Ci ha informato [Isma'il bin Ja'far] da [Israil] da [Abu Ishaq] da ['Amru] da [Umar bin Al Khathab] disse, "quando has è sceso divieto vino Umar said, "O Allah, explain a we regarding vino con explanation chi satisfying." poi was revealed verse chi found dalam chapter Al Baqarah (219): '(They ha chiesto a you regarding khamr e gambling…) '. 'Ammar said, "poi Umar è stato chiamato e was recited a him verse che, disse again, "O Allah, explain a we regarding khamr con explanation chi satisfying." poi was revealed verse chi found on chapter An Nisaa` (41): '(O persona-persona chi believed, do non you shalat, è you dalam condizione ubriaco…..) ' Penyeru Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui quando shalat has was established poi he berseru, 'ketahuilah che non may persona chi ubriaco mendekati shalat! ' poi Umar è stato chiamato e was recited verse che a him, poi disse, "O Allah explain a we regarding khamr con explanation chi satisfying!" poi was revealed verse questo: '(….. whether voi tutti farà stopped?) ' (Qs. Al Maa`idah: 91) Umar said, "We has stopped."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامأَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ دَعَاهُ وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ فَسَقَاهُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَرَّمَ الْخَمْرُ فَأَمَّهُمْ عَلِيٌّ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ فَقَرَأَ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ فَخَلَطَ فِيهَا فَنَزَلَتْ{ لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا مَا تَقُولُونَ }
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musaddad] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya] dari [Sufyan] telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Atha bin As Saib] dari [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] dari [Ali bin Abu Thalib] bahwa seorang laki-laki Anshar memanggil dirinya dan Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, lalu ia memberi mereka minum khamer sebelum khamer diharamkan. Setelah itu Ali mengimami mereka dalam Shalat Maghrib. Ketika ia membaca Surat Al Ikhlash dan terbolak-balik dalam membacanya, maka turunlah ayat: '(Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah kamu shalat, sedang kamu dalam keadaan mabuk, sehingga kamu mengerti apa yang kamu ucapkan…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musaddad] narrated to us [Yahya] from [Sufyan] narrated to us ['Atha bin As Saib] from [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] from [Ali bin Abu Thalib] that a man-man Anshar memanggil himself and Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, then he gave they drank khamr before khamr was prohibited. After that Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat Sunset. When he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash and terbolak-balik dalam read it, then was revealed verse: '(O person-person who believed, do not you shalat, is you dalam condition intoxicated, sehingga you understood what who you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musaddad] 私たちに語った [Yahya] から [Sufyan] 私たちに語った ['Atha bin As Saib] から [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] から [Ali bin Abu Thalib] その a 男-男 Anshar memanggil himself そして Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, それから he 与えた they 飲んだ ハムル 〜の前に ハムル was prohibited. 〜の後に その Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat 日没. 〜のとき he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash そして terbolak-balik dalam read it, それから was revealed verse: '(O 人-人 誰 believed, do 〜ない you shalat, である you dalam 条件 酔った, sehingga you 理解した 何 誰 you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musaddad] 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya] 부터 [Sufyan] 우리에게 전했다 ['Atha bin As Saib] 부터 [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] 부터 [Ali bin Abu Thalib] 그 a 남자-남자 Anshar memanggil himself そして Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, 그러자 he 주었다 they 마셨다 함르 전에 함르 was prohibited. 후에 그 Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat 일몰. ~할 때 he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash そして terbolak-balik dalam read it, 그러자 was revealed verse: '(O 사람-사람 누구 believed, do ~아니다 you shalat, 이다 you dalam 조건 취한, sehingga you 이해했다 무엇 누구 you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musaddad] 向我们讲述 [Yahya] 从 [Sufyan] 向我们讲述 ['Atha bin As Saib] 从 [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] 从 [Ali bin Abu Thalib] 那 a 男人-男人 Anshar memanggil himself 和 Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, 然后 he 给 they 喝 哈姆尔酒 之前 哈姆尔酒 was prohibited. 之后 那 Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat 日落. 当 he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash 和 terbolak-balik dalam read it, 然后 was revealed verse: '(O 人-人 谁 believed, do 不 you shalat, 是 you dalam 条件 醉, sehingga you 理解 什么 谁 you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musaddad] Nous a raconté [Yahya] de [Sufyan] Nous a raconté ['Atha bin As Saib] de [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] de [Ali bin Abu Thalib] que a homme-homme Anshar memanggil himself et Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, puis he a donné they a bu khamr avant khamr was prohibited. après que Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat coucher du soleil. quand he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash et terbolak-balik dalam read it, puis was revealed verse: '(O personne-personne qui believed, do pas you shalat, est you dalam condition ivre, sehingga you a compris quoi qui you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musaddad] Hat uns erzählt [Yahya] von [Sufyan] Hat uns erzählt ['Atha bin As Saib] von [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] von [Ali bin Abu Thalib] dass a Mann-Mann Anshar memanggil himself und Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, dann he gab they trank Khamr vor Khamr was prohibited. nach dass Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat Sonnenuntergang. wenn he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash und terbolak-balik dalam read it, dann was revealed verse: '(O Person-Person wer believed, do nicht you shalat, ist you dalam Bedingung berauscht, sehingga you verstand was wer you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musaddad] Ci ha narrato [Yahya] da [Sufyan] Ci ha narrato ['Atha bin As Saib] da [Abu Abdurrahman As Sulami] da [Ali bin Abu Thalib] che a uomo-uomo Anshar memanggil himself e Abdurrahman bin 'Auf, poi he ha dato they ha bevuto khamr prima khamr was prohibited. dopo che Ali mengimami they dalam Shalat tramonto. quando he membaca chapter Al Ikhlash e terbolak-balik dalam read it, poi was revealed verse: '(O persona-persona chi believed, do non you shalat, è you dalam condizione ubriaco, sehingga you ha capito cosa chi you say…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41).

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَرْوَزِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ{ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى }وَ{ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنْ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِمَا إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ }نَسَخَتْهُمَا الَّتِي فِي الْمَائِدَةِ{ إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنْصَابُ }الْآيَةَ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ali bin Husain] dari [Ayahnya] dari [Yazid An Nahwi] dari [Ikrimah] dari [Ibnu Abbas] ia membaca: '(Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah kamu shalat, sedang kamu dalam keadaan mabuk…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). Dan ayat: '(Mereka bertanya kepadamu tentang khamer dan judi. Katakanlah: "Pada keduanya terdapat dosa yang besar dan beberapa manfaat bagi manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), ia berkata, "Kedua ayat tersebut dihapus dan digantikan oleh ayat yang terdapat dalam Surat Al Maaidah: 91: '(Sesungguhnya (meminum) khamar, berjudi, (berkorban untuk) berhala…) '.
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] narrated to us [Ali bin Husain] from [his father] from [Yazid An Nahwi] from [Ikrimah] from [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O person-person who believed, do not you shalat, is you dalam condition intoxicated…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). And verse: '(They asked to you regarding khamr and gambling. Say: "On both of them found sin who great and beberapa manfaat for manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), he said, "Second verse that dihapus and was replaced by verse who found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (drank) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed for) berhala…) '.
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] 私たちに語った [Ali bin Husain] から [his father] から [Yazid An Nahwi] から [Ikrimah] から [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O 人-人 誰 believed, do 〜ない you shalat, である you dalam 条件 酔った…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). そして verse: '(They 尋ねた へ you regarding ハムル そして gambling. Say: "On both の them found 罪 誰 偉大な そして beberapa manfaat 〜のために manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), 彼は言った, "第二 verse その dihapus そして was replaced by verse 誰 found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (飲んだ) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed 〜のために) berhala…) '.
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] 우리에게 전했다 [Ali bin Husain] 부터 [his father] 부터 [Yazid An Nahwi] 부터 [Ikrimah] 부터 [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O 사람-사람 누구 believed, do ~아니다 you shalat, 이다 you dalam 조건 취한…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). そして verse: '(They 물었다 에게 you regarding 함르 そして gambling. Say: "On both 의 them found 죄 누구 위대한 そして beberapa manfaat 위해 manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), 그는 말했다, "둘째 verse 그 dihapus そして was replaced by verse 누구 found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (마셨다) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed 위해) berhala…) '.
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] 向我们讲述 [Ali bin Husain] 从 [his father] 从 [Yazid An Nahwi] 从 [Ikrimah] 从 [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O 人-人 谁 believed, do 不 you shalat, 是 you dalam 条件 醉…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). 和 verse: '(They 问 向 you regarding 哈姆尔酒 和 gambling. Say: "On both 的 them found 罪 谁 伟大 和 beberapa manfaat 为 manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), 他说, "第二 verse 那 dihapus 和 was replaced by verse 谁 found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (喝) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed 为) berhala…) '.
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] Nous a raconté [Ali bin Husain] de [his father] de [Yazid An Nahwi] de [Ikrimah] de [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O personne-personne qui believed, do pas you shalat, est you dalam condition ivre…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). et verse: '(They a demandé à you regarding khamr et gambling. Say: "On both de them found péché qui grand et beberapa manfaat pour manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), il a dit, "deuxième verse que dihapus et was replaced by verse qui found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (a bu) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed pour) berhala…) '.
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] Hat uns erzählt [Ali bin Husain] von [his father] von [Yazid An Nahwi] von [Ikrimah] von [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O Person-Person wer believed, do nicht you shalat, ist you dalam Bedingung berauscht…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). und verse: '(They fragte zu you regarding Khamr und gambling. Say: "On both von them found Sünde wer groß und beberapa manfaat für manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), er sagte, "zweiter verse dass dihapus und was replaced by verse wer found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (trank) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed für) berhala…) '.
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Ahmad bin Muhammad Al Marwazi] Ci ha narrato [Ali bin Husain] da [his father] da [Yazid An Nahwi] da [Ikrimah] da [Ibnu Abbas] he membaca: '(O persona-persona chi believed, do non you shalat, è you dalam condizione ubriaco…) ' (Qs. An Nisaa`: 41). e verse: '(They ha chiesto a you regarding khamr e gambling. Say: "On both di them found peccato chi grande e beberapa manfaat per manusia.....) ' (Qs. Al Baqarah: 219), disse, "secondo verse che dihapus e was replaced by verse chi found dalam chapter Al Maaidah: 91: '(indeed (ha bevuto) khamar, berjudi, (sacrificed per) berhala…) '.

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَكُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ حَيْثُ حُرِّمَتْ الْخَمْرُ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمَا شَرَابُنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلَّا الْفَضِيخُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ وَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْنَا هَذَا مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sulaiman bin Harb] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Hammad bin Zaid] dari [Tsabit] dari [Anas] ia berkata, "Aku pernah memberi orang-orang minum khamer di waktu khamer telah diharamkan di rumah Abu Thalhah. Ketika itu minuman kami terbuat uii Fadlikh (khamer dari kurma muda). Kemudian ada seorang laki-laki masuk menemui kami dan berkata, 'sesungguhnya khamer telah diharamkan, dan penyeru Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam telah mengumumkan', maka kami pun berkata, "Ini adalah penyeru Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Sulaiman bin Harb] narrated to us [Hammad bin Zaid] from [Tsabit] from [Anas] he said, "I ever gave person-person drank khamr in time khamr has was prohibited in house Abu Thalhah. When that beverage we made of uii Fadlikh (khamr from dates muda). Then there is a man-man entered met we and said, 'indeed khamr has was prohibited, and penyeru The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him has mengumumkan', then we also said, "This is penyeru The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Sulaiman bin Harb] 私たちに語った [Hammad bin Zaid] から [Tsabit] から [Anas] 彼は言った, "I かつて 与えた 人-人 飲んだ ハムル 〜に 時 ハムル has was prohibited 〜に 家 Abu Thalhah. 〜のとき その 飲料 we 作った の uii Fadlikh (ハムル から ナツメヤシ muda). それから there である a 男-男 入った 会った we そして said, 'indeed ハムル has was prohibited, そして penyeru アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） has mengumumkan', それから we また said, "この である penyeru アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Sulaiman bin Harb] 우리에게 전했다 [Hammad bin Zaid] 부터 [Tsabit] 부터 [Anas] 그는 말했다, "I 한 번이라도 주었다 사람-사람 마셨다 함르 에 시간 함르 has was prohibited 에 집 Abu Thalhah. ~할 때 그 음료 we 만들었다 의 uii Fadlikh (함르 부터 대추 muda). 그러자 there 이다 a 남자-남자 들어갔다 만났다 we そして said, 'indeed 함르 has was prohibited, そして penyeru 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) has mengumumkan', 그러자 we 또한 said, "이 이다 penyeru 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를)."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Sulaiman bin Harb] 向我们讲述 [Hammad bin Zaid] 从 [Tsabit] 从 [Anas] 他说, "I 曾经 给 人-人 喝 哈姆尔酒 在 时间 哈姆尔酒 has was prohibited 在 房子 Abu Thalhah. 当 那 饮料 we 制作 的 uii Fadlikh (哈姆尔酒 从 椰枣 muda). 然后 there 是 a 男人-男人 进入 遇到 we 和 said, 'indeed 哈姆尔酒 has was prohibited, 和 penyeru 安拉的使者（愿他平安） has mengumumkan', 然后 we 也 said, "这 是 penyeru 安拉的使者（愿他平安）."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Sulaiman bin Harb] Nous a raconté [Hammad bin Zaid] de [Tsabit] de [Anas] il a dit, "I jamais a donné personne-personne a bu khamr dans temps khamr has was prohibited dans maison Abu Thalhah. quand que boisson we a fait de uii Fadlikh (khamr de dattes muda). puis there est a homme-homme est entré a rencontré we et said, 'indeed khamr has was prohibited, et penyeru Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui has mengumumkan', puis we aussi said, "ce est penyeru Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Sulaiman bin Harb] Hat uns erzählt [Hammad bin Zaid] von [Tsabit] von [Anas] er sagte, "I je gab Person-Person trank Khamr in Zeit Khamr has was prohibited in Haus Abu Thalhah. wenn dass Getränk we machte von uii Fadlikh (Khamr von Datteln muda). dann there ist a Mann-Mann trat ein traf we und said, 'indeed Khamr has was prohibited, und penyeru Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm has mengumumkan', dann we auch said, "dies ist penyeru Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Sulaiman bin Harb] Ci ha narrato [Hammad bin Zaid] da [Tsabit] da [Anas] disse, "I mai ha dato persona-persona ha bevuto khamr in tempo khamr has was prohibited in casa Abu Thalhah. quando che bevanda we ha fatto di uii Fadlikh (khamr da datteri muda). poi there è a uomo-uomo è entrato ha incontrato we e said, 'indeed khamr has was prohibited, e penyeru Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui has mengumumkan', poi we anche said, "questo è penyeru Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعُ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ مَوْلَاهُمْ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَافِقِيِّ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْخَمْرَ وَشَارِبَهَا وَسَاقِيَهَا وَبَائِعَهَا وَمُبْتَاعَهَا وَعَاصِرَهَا وَمُعْتَصِرَهَا وَحَامِلَهَا وَالْمَحْمُولَةَ إِلَيْهِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] dari [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] dari [Abu 'Alqamah] mantan budak mereka, dan [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] bahwa keduanya telah mendengar [Ibnu Umar] berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Semoga Allah melaknat khamer, peminumnya, yang menuangkannya, penjualnya, pembelinya, pemerasnya, orang yang diperaskannya, orang yang membawanya dan orang yang dibawakan kepadanya."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] narrated to us [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] from [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] from [Abu 'Alqamah] former slave they, and [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] that both of them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "Semoga Allah melaknat khamr, its drinker, who poured it, its seller, its buyer, its presser, person who was pressed, person who brought it and person who was brought to him."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] 私たちに語った [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] から [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] から [Abu 'Alqamah] former 奴隷 they, そして [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] その both の them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "Semoga Allah melaknat ハムル, its drinker, 誰 注いだ it, its 売り手, its 買い手, its presser, 人 誰 was 搾った, 人 誰 持って来た it そして 人 誰 was 持って来た へ him."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] 우리에게 전했다 [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] 부터 [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] 부터 [Abu 'Alqamah] former 노예 they, そして [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] 그 both 의 them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "Semoga Allah melaknat 함르, its drinker, 누구 부었다 it, its 판매자, its 구매자, its presser, 사람 누구 was 짰다, 사람 누구 가져왔다 it そして 사람 누구 was 가져왔다 에게 him."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] 向我们讲述 [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] 从 [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] 从 [Abu 'Alqamah] former 奴隶 they, 和 [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] 那 both 的 them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "Semoga Allah melaknat 哈姆尔酒, its drinker, 谁 倒 it, its 卖方, its 买方, its presser, 人 谁 was 压榨, 人 谁 带来 it 和 人 谁 was 带来 向 him."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] Nous a raconté [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] de [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] de [Abu 'Alqamah] former esclave they, et [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] que both de them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "Semoga Allah melaknat khamr, its drinker, qui a versé it, its vendeur, its acheteur, its presser, personne qui was a pressé, personne qui a apporté it et personne qui was a apporté à him."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] Hat uns erzählt [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] von [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] von [Abu 'Alqamah] former Sklave they, und [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] dass both von them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "Semoga Allah melaknat Khamr, its drinker, wer goss it, its Verkäufer, its Käufer, its presser, Person wer was presste, Person wer brachte it und Person wer was brachte zu him."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Utsman bin Abu Syaibah] Ci ha narrato [Waki' bin Al Jarrah] da [Abdul Aziz bin Umar] da [Abu 'Alqamah] former schiavo they, e [Abdurrahman bin Abdullah Al Ghafiqi] che both di them has heard [Ibnu Umar] said, "Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "Semoga Allah melaknat khamr, its drinker, chi ha versato it, its venditore, its acquirente, its presser, persona chi was ha spremuto, persona chi ha portato it e persona chi was ha portato a him."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُبَيْرَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍأَنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ أَيْتَامٍ وَرِثُوا خَمْرًا قَالَ أَهْرِقْهَا قَالَ أَفَلَا أَجْعَلُهَا خَلًّا قَالَ لَا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Zuhair bin Hazb] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Waki'] dari [Sufyan] dari [As Saddi] dari [Abu Hubairah] dari [Anas bin Malik] bahwa Abu Thalhah bertanya kepada Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam mengenai anak-anak yatim yang mewarisi khamer. Beliau bersabda: "Tumpahkanlah khamer tersebut!" Abu Thalhah bertanya, "Bolehkah aku jadikan cuka?" Beliau menjawab: "Tidak."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Zuhair bin Hazb] narrated to us [Waki'] from [Sufyan] from [As Saddi] from [Abu Hubairah] from [Anas bin Malik] that Abu Thalhah asked to The Prophet, peace be upon him regarding child-child orphan who mewarisi khamr. He said: "pour out khamr that!" Abu Thalhah asked, "Is it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "Not."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Zuhair bin Hazb] 私たちに語った [Waki'] から [Sufyan] から [As Saddi] から [Abu Hubairah] から [Anas bin Malik] その Abu Thalhah 尋ねた へ 預言者（彼に平安あれ） regarding 子-子 孤児 誰 mewarisi ハムル. 彼は言った: "注ぐ out ハムル その!" Abu Thalhah 尋ねた, "である it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "〜ない."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Zuhair bin Hazb] 우리에게 전했다 [Waki'] 부터 [Sufyan] 부터 [As Saddi] 부터 [Abu Hubairah] 부터 [Anas bin Malik] 그 Abu Thalhah 물었다 에게 예언자(그에게 평화가 있기를) regarding 자녀-자녀 고아 누구 mewarisi 함르. 그는 말했다: "붓다 out 함르 그!" Abu Thalhah 물었다, "이다 it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "~아니다."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Zuhair bin Hazb] 向我们讲述 [Waki'] 从 [Sufyan] 从 [As Saddi] 从 [Abu Hubairah] 从 [Anas bin Malik] 那 Abu Thalhah 问 向 先知（愿他平安） regarding 孩子-孩子 孤儿 谁 mewarisi 哈姆尔酒. 他说: "倒 out 哈姆尔酒 那!" Abu Thalhah 问, "是 it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "不."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Zuhair bin Hazb] Nous a raconté [Waki'] de [Sufyan] de [As Saddi] de [Abu Hubairah] de [Anas bin Malik] que Abu Thalhah a demandé à Le Prophète, que la paix soit sur lui regarding enfant-enfant orphelin qui mewarisi khamr. il a dit: "verser out khamr que!" Abu Thalhah a demandé, "est it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "pas."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Zuhair bin Hazb] Hat uns erzählt [Waki'] von [Sufyan] von [As Saddi] von [Abu Hubairah] von [Anas bin Malik] dass Abu Thalhah fragte zu Der Prophet, Friede sei mit ihm regarding Kind-Kind Waise wer mewarisi Khamr. er sagte: "gießen out Khamr dass!" Abu Thalhah fragte, "ist it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "nicht."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Zuhair bin Hazb] Ci ha narrato [Waki'] da [Sufyan] da [As Saddi] da [Abu Hubairah] da [Anas bin Malik] che Abu Thalhah ha chiesto a Il Profeta, pace su di lui regarding figlio-figlio orfano chi mewarisi khamr. disse: "versare out khamr che!" Abu Thalhah ha chiesto, "è it allowed I make cuka?" He answered: "non."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ قَالَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِنَّ مِنْ الْعِنَبِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنْ التَّمْرِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنْ الْعَسَلِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنْ الْبُرِّ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنْ الشَّعِيرِ خَمْرًا
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Al Hasan bin Ali] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Yahya bin Adam] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Israil] dari [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] dari [Asy Sya'bi] dari [An Nu'man bin Basyir] ia berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesungguhnya anggur bisa jadi khamer, kurma bisa jadi khamer, madu bisa jadi khamer, gandum bisa jadi khamer dan jewawut juga bisa jadi khamer."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Al Hasan bin Ali] narrated to us [Yahya bin Adam] narrated to us [Israil] from [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] from [Asy Sya'bi] from [An Nu'man bin Basyir] he said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "indeed grapes can became khamr, dates can became khamr, honey can became khamr, wheat can became khamr and millet also can became khamr."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Al Hasan bin Ali] 私たちに語った [Yahya bin Adam] 私たちに語った [Israil] から [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] から [Asy Sya'bi] から [An Nu'man bin Basyir] 彼は言った, "アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "indeed ブドウ can became ハムル, ナツメヤシ can became ハムル, 蜂蜜 can became ハムル, 小麦 can became ハムル そして キビ また can became ハムル."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Al Hasan bin Ali] 우리에게 전했다 [Yahya bin Adam] 우리에게 전했다 [Israil] 부터 [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] 부터 [Asy Sya'bi] 부터 [An Nu'man bin Basyir] 그는 말했다, "알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "indeed 포도 can became 함르, 대추 can became 함르, 꿀 can became 함르, 밀 can became 함르 そして 기장 또한 can became 함르."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Al Hasan bin Ali] 向我们讲述 [Yahya bin Adam] 向我们讲述 [Israil] 从 [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] 从 [Asy Sya'bi] 从 [An Nu'man bin Basyir] 他说, "安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "indeed 葡萄 can became 哈姆尔酒, 椰枣 can became 哈姆尔酒, 蜂蜜 can became 哈姆尔酒, 小麦 can became 哈姆尔酒 和 小米 也 can became 哈姆尔酒."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Al Hasan bin Ali] Nous a raconté [Yahya bin Adam] Nous a raconté [Israil] de [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] de [Asy Sya'bi] de [An Nu'man bin Basyir] il a dit, "Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "indeed raisins can became khamr, dattes can became khamr, miel can became khamr, blé can became khamr et millet aussi can became khamr."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Al Hasan bin Ali] Hat uns erzählt [Yahya bin Adam] Hat uns erzählt [Israil] von [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] von [Asy Sya'bi] von [An Nu'man bin Basyir] er sagte, "Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "indeed Trauben can became Khamr, Datteln can became Khamr, Honig can became Khamr, Weizen can became Khamr und Hirse auch can became Khamr."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Al Hasan bin Ali] Ci ha narrato [Yahya bin Adam] Ci ha narrato [Israil] da [Ibrahim bin Muhajir] da [Asy Sya'bi] da [An Nu'man bin Basyir] disse, "Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "indeed uva can became khamr, datteri can became khamr, miele can became khamr, grano can became khamr e miglio anche can became khamr."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَرِيزٍ أَنَّ عَامِرًا حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ قَالَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ مِنْ الْعَصِيرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالذُّرَةِ وَإِنِّي أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ كُلِّ مُسْكِرٍ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Mu'tamir] ia berkata; aku membacakan riwayat kepada [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] dari [Abu Hariz] bahwa [Amir] menceritakan kepadanya, bahwa [An Nu'man bin Basyir] berkata, "Aku mendengar Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesungguhnya khamer terbuat dari perasan, anggur, kurma, biji gandum, jewawut, dan jagung. Dan aku melarang kalian dari segala sesuatu yang memabukkan."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] narrated to us [Mu'tamir] he said; I recited riwayat to [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] from [Abu Hariz] that [Amir] narrated to him, that [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "I heard The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "indeed khamr made of from juice, grapes, dates, seeds wheat, millet, and jagung. And I forbade you all from segala something who intoxicating."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] 私たちに語った [Mu'tamir] 彼は言った; I recited riwayat へ [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] から [Abu Hariz] その [Amir] 伝えた へ him, その [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "私は聞いた アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "indeed ハムル 作った の から ジュース, ブドウ, ナツメヤシ, 種 小麦, キビ, そして jagung. そして I 禁じた あなたがた から segala something 誰 酔わせる."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] 우리에게 전했다 [Mu'tamir] 그는 말했다; I recited riwayat 에게 [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] 부터 [Abu Hariz] 그 [Amir] 전했다 에게 him, 그 [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "나는 들었다 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "indeed 함르 만들었다 의 부터 즙, 포도, 대추, 씨앗 밀, 기장, そして jagung. そして I 금지했다 너희들 부터 segala something 누구 취하게 하는."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] 向我们讲述 [Mu'tamir] 他说; I recited riwayat 向 [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] 从 [Abu Hariz] 那 [Amir] 讲述 向 him, 那 [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "我听到 安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "indeed 哈姆尔酒 制作 的 从 果汁, 葡萄, 椰枣, 种子 小麦, 小米, 和 jagung. 和 I 禁止 你们 从 segala something 谁 使人醉."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] Nous a raconté [Mu'tamir] il a dit; I recited riwayat à [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] de [Abu Hariz] que [Amir] a raconté à him, que [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "j'ai entendu Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "indeed khamr a fait de de jus, raisins, dattes, graines blé, millet, et jagung. et I a interdit vous tous de segala something qui enivrant."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] Hat uns erzählt [Mu'tamir] er sagte; I recited riwayat zu [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] von [Abu Hariz] dass [Amir] erzählte zu him, dass [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "ich hörte Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "indeed Khamr machte von von Saft, Trauben, Datteln, Samen Weizen, Hirse, und jagung. und I verbot ihr alle von segala something wer berauschend."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Malik bin Abdul Wahid Abu Ghassan] Ci ha narrato [Mu'tamir] disse; I recited riwayat a [Al Fudlail bin Maisarah] da [Abu Hariz] che [Amir] ha narrato a him, che [An Nu'man bin Basyir] said, "ho sentito Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "indeed khamr ha fatto di da succo, uva, datteri, semi grano, miglio, e jagung. e I ha proibito voi tutti da segala something chi inebriante."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد اسْمُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ الْغُبَرِيِّ يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غُفَيْلَةَ السَّحْمِيِّ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أُذَيْنَةُ وَالصَّوَابُ غُفَيْلَةُ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musa bin Isma'il] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Aban] telah menceritakan kepadaku [Yahya] dari [Abu Katsir] dari [Abu Hurairah] bahwa Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Khamer terbuat dari kedua pohon ini; pohon kurma dan anggur." Abu Daud berkata, "Nama Abu Katsir adalah Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah As Sahmi. Sedang yang lain mengatakan Udzainah, dan yang benar adalah Ghufailah."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musa bin Isma'il] narrated to us [Aban] narrated to me [Yahya] from [Abu Katsir] from [Abu Hurairah] that The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "Khamr made of from second tree this; tree dates and grapes." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir is Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah As Sahmi. Is who lain said Udzainah, and who true is Ghufailah."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musa bin Isma'il] 私たちに語った [Aban] 私に語った [Yahya] から [Abu Katsir] から [Abu Hurairah] その アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "ハムル 作った の から 第二 木 この; 木 ナツメヤシ そして ブドウ." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir である Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah 〜として Sahmi. である 誰 lain said Udzainah, そして 誰 真実の である Ghufailah."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musa bin Isma'il] 우리에게 전했다 [Aban] 나에게 전했다 [Yahya] 부터 [Abu Katsir] 부터 [Abu Hurairah] 그 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "함르 만들었다 의 부터 둘째 나무 이; 나무 대추 そして 포도." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir 이다 Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah ~로서 Sahmi. 이다 누구 lain said Udzainah, そして 누구 참 이다 Ghufailah."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musa bin Isma'il] 向我们讲述 [Aban] 向我讲述 [Yahya] 从 [Abu Katsir] 从 [Abu Hurairah] 那 安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "哈姆尔酒 制作 的 从 第二 树 这; 树 椰枣 和 葡萄." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir 是 Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah 作为 Sahmi. 是 谁 lain said Udzainah, 和 谁 真 是 Ghufailah."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musa bin Isma'il] Nous a raconté [Aban] M'a raconté [Yahya] de [Abu Katsir] de [Abu Hurairah] que Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "khamr a fait de de deuxième arbre ce; arbre dattes et raisins." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir est Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah comme Sahmi. est qui lain said Udzainah, et qui vrai est Ghufailah."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musa bin Isma'il] Hat uns erzählt [Aban] Hat mir erzählt [Yahya] von [Abu Katsir] von [Abu Hurairah] dass Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "Khamr machte von von zweiter Baum dies; Baum Datteln und Trauben." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir ist Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah als Sahmi. ist wer lain said Udzainah, und wer wahr ist Ghufailah."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musa bin Isma'il] Ci ha narrato [Aban] Mi ha narrato [Yahya] da [Abu Katsir] da [Abu Hurairah] che Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "khamr ha fatto di da secondo albero questo; albero datteri e uva." Abu Daud said, "Name Abu Katsir è Al Ghubarah Yazid bin Abdurrahman bin Ghufailah come Sahmi. è chi lain said Udzainah, e chi vero è Ghufailah."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى فِي آخَرِينَ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ خَمْرٌ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَنْ مَاتَ وَهُوَ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ يُدْمِنُهَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sulaiman bin Daud] dan [Muhammad bin Isa] di antara yang lain. Mereka berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Hammad bin Zaid] dari [Ayyub] dari [Nafi'] dari [Ibnu Umar] ia berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Setiap sesuatu yang memabukkan adalah khamer, dan setiap yang memabukkan adalah haram. Barangsiapa meninggal dalam keadaan minum khamer dan menyukainya maka ia tidak akan meminumnya pada Hari Kiamat."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Sulaiman bin Daud] and [Muhammad bin Isa] in between who lain. They said; narrated to us [Hammad bin Zaid] from [Ayyub] from [Nafi'] from [Ibnu Umar] he said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "Each something who intoxicating is khamr, and each who intoxicating is haram. Whoever died dalam condition drank khamr and liked it then he not will drank it on Day Kiamat."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Sulaiman bin Daud] そして [Muhammad bin Isa] 〜に 〜の間に 誰 lain. 彼らは言った; 私たちに語った [Hammad bin Zaid] から [Ayyub] から [Nafi'] から [Ibnu Umar] 彼は言った, "アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "各 something 誰 酔わせる である ハムル, そして 各 誰 酔わせる である ハラーム. 〜する者は誰でも 死んだ dalam 条件 飲んだ ハムル そして 好んだ it それから he 〜ない 〜だろう それを飲んだ on 日 Kiamat."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Sulaiman bin Daud] そして [Muhammad bin Isa] 에 사이에 누구 lain. 그들은 말했다; 우리에게 전했다 [Hammad bin Zaid] 부터 [Ayyub] 부터 [Nafi'] 부터 [Ibnu Umar] 그는 말했다, "알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "각 something 누구 취하게 하는 이다 함르, そして 각 누구 취하게 하는 이다 하람. ~하는 자는 누구든 죽었다 dalam 조건 마셨다 함르 そして 좋아했다 it 그러자 he ~아니다 ~할 것이다 그것을 마셨다 on 날 Kiamat."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Sulaiman bin Daud] 和 [Muhammad bin Isa] 在 之间 谁 lain. 他们说; 向我们讲述 [Hammad bin Zaid] 从 [Ayyub] 从 [Nafi'] 从 [Ibnu Umar] 他说, "安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "每 something 谁 使人醉 是 哈姆尔酒, 和 每 谁 使人醉 是 非法. 凡是 去世 dalam 条件 喝 哈姆尔酒 和 喜欢 it 然后 he 不 将 喝了它 on 天 Kiamat."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Sulaiman bin Daud] et [Muhammad bin Isa] dans entre qui lain. ils ont dit; Nous a raconté [Hammad bin Zaid] de [Ayyub] de [Nafi'] de [Ibnu Umar] il a dit, "Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "chaque something qui enivrant est khamr, et chaque qui enivrant est haram. Quiconque est mort dalam condition a bu khamr et a aimé it puis he pas va l'a bu on jour Kiamat."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Sulaiman bin Daud] und [Muhammad bin Isa] in zwischen wer lain. sie sagten; Hat uns erzählt [Hammad bin Zaid] von [Ayyub] von [Nafi'] von [Ibnu Umar] er sagte, "Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "jeder something wer berauschend ist Khamr, und jeder wer berauschend ist haram. Wer auch immer starb dalam Bedingung trank Khamr und mochte it dann he nicht wird trank es on Tag Kiamat."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Sulaiman bin Daud] e [Muhammad bin Isa] in tra chi lain. dissero; Ci ha narrato [Hammad bin Zaid] da [Ayyub] da [Nafi'] da [Ibnu Umar] disse, "Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "ogni something chi inebriante è khamr, e ogni chi inebriante è haram. Chiunque è morto dalam condizione ha bevuto khamr e ha gradito it poi he non farà l'ha bevuto on giorno Kiamat."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ يَقُولُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍعَنْ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ كُلُّ مُخَمِّرٍ خَمْرٌ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَنْ شَرِبَ مُسْكِرًا بُخِسَتْ صَلَاتُهُ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ عَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ الْخَبَالِ قِيلَ وَمَا طِينَةُ الْخَبَالِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ صَدِيدُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ صَغِيرًا لَا يَعْرِفُ حَلَالَهُ مِنْ حَرَامِهِ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ الْخَبَالِ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] ia berkata; aku mendengar [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] berkata dari [Thawus] dari [Ibnu Abbas] dari Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, beliau bersabda: "Segala sesuatu yang memabukkan adalah khamer, dan segala sesuatu yang memabukkan adalah haram. Barangsiapa minum sesuatu yang memabukkan maka shalatnya selama empat puluh pagi tidak diterima, apabila ia bertaubat maka Allah akan memberinya taubat. Dan jika pada kali keempatnya ia kembali minum, maka menjadi hak atas Allah untuk memberinya minum dari thinah al khabal." Beliau ditanya, "Wahai Rasulullah, apakah thinah al khabal itu?" Beliau Menjawab: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. Dan barangsiapa memberi minum khamer anak kecil, sementara anak kecil tidaklah mengetahui halal dan haramnya, maka Allah akan memberinya minum dari thinah al khabal."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] narrated to us [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] he said; I heard [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said from [Thawus] from [Ibnu Abbas] from The Prophet, peace be upon him, he said: "Segala something who intoxicating is khamr, and segala something who intoxicating is haram. Whoever drank something who intoxicating then his prayer selama four puluh morning not was received, when he bertaubat then Allah will gave him taubat. And if on times the fourth of them he returned drank, then became right over Allah for gave him drank from thinah al khabal." He was asked, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal that?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. And whoever gave drank khamr child small, while child small not knew halal and its prohibition, then Allah will gave him drank from thinah al khabal."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] 私たちに語った [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] 彼は言った; 私は聞いた [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said から [Thawus] から [Ibnu Abbas] から 預言者（彼に平安あれ）, 彼は言った: "Segala something 誰 酔わせる である ハムル, そして segala something 誰 酔わせる である ハラーム. 〜する者は誰でも 飲んだ something 誰 酔わせる それから his 礼拝 selama 四 puluh 朝 〜ない was 受け取った, 〜のとき he bertaubat それから Allah 〜だろう 与えた him taubat. そして もし on 回 the 第四 の them he 戻った 飲んだ, それから became 権利 over Allah 〜のために 与えた him 飲んだ から thinah al khabal." He was 尋ねた, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal その?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. そして 〜する者は誰でも 与えた 飲んだ ハムル 子 小さな, 〜の間 子 小さな 〜ない 知った ハラール そして its 禁止, それから Allah 〜だろう 与えた him 飲んだ から thinah al khabal."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] 우리에게 전했다 [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] 그는 말했다; 나는 들었다 [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said 부터 [Thawus] 부터 [Ibnu Abbas] 부터 예언자(그에게 평화가 있기를), 그는 말했다: "Segala something 누구 취하게 하는 이다 함르, そして segala something 누구 취하게 하는 이다 하람. ~하는 자는 누구든 마셨다 something 누구 취하게 하는 그러자 his 기도 selama 넷 puluh 아침 ~아니다 was 받았다, ~할 때 he bertaubat 그러자 Allah ~할 것이다 주었다 him taubat. そして 만약 on 번 the 넷째 의 them he 돌아왔다 마셨다, 그러자 became 권리 over Allah 위해 주었다 him 마셨다 부터 thinah al khabal." He was 물었다, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal 그?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. そして ~하는 자는 누구든 주었다 마셨다 함르 자녀 작은, 동안 자녀 작은 ~아니다 알았다 할랄 そして its 금지, 그러자 Allah ~할 것이다 주었다 him 마셨다 부터 thinah al khabal."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] 向我们讲述 [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] 他说; 我听到 [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said 从 [Thawus] 从 [Ibnu Abbas] 从 先知（愿他平安）, 他说: "Segala something 谁 使人醉 是 哈姆尔酒, 和 segala something 谁 使人醉 是 非法. 凡是 喝 something 谁 使人醉 然后 his 礼拜 selama 四 puluh 早晨 不 was 收到, 当 he bertaubat 然后 Allah 将 给 him taubat. 和 如果 on 次 the 第四 的 them he 回来 喝, 然后 became 权利 over Allah 为 给 him 喝 从 thinah al khabal." He was 问, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal 那?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. 和 凡是 给 喝 哈姆尔酒 孩子 小, 当 孩子 小 不 知道 清真 和 its 禁止, 然后 Allah 将 给 him 喝 从 thinah al khabal."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] Nous a raconté [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] il a dit; j'ai entendu [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said de [Thawus] de [Ibnu Abbas] de Le Prophète, que la paix soit sur lui, il a dit: "Segala something qui enivrant est khamr, et segala something qui enivrant est haram. Quiconque a bu something qui enivrant puis his prière selama quatre puluh matin pas was a reçu, quand he bertaubat puis Allah va a donné him taubat. et si on fois the quatrième de them he est revenu a bu, puis became droit over Allah pour a donné him a bu de thinah al khabal." He was a demandé, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal que?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. et Quiconque a donné a bu khamr enfant petit, pendant que enfant petit pas a su halal et its interdiction, puis Allah va a donné him a bu de thinah al khabal."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] Hat uns erzählt [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] er sagte; ich hörte [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said von [Thawus] von [Ibnu Abbas] von Der Prophet, Friede sei mit ihm, er sagte: "Segala something wer berauschend ist Khamr, und segala something wer berauschend ist haram. Wer auch immer trank something wer berauschend dann his Gebet selama vier puluh Morgen nicht was empfing, wenn he bertaubat dann Allah wird gab him taubat. und wenn on mal the vierter von them he kehrte zurück trank, dann became Recht over Allah für gab him trank von thinah al khabal." He was fragte, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal dass?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. und Wer auch immer gab trank Khamr Kind klein, während Kind klein nicht wusste halal und its Verbot, dann Allah wird gab him trank von thinah al khabal."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Muhammad bin Rafi' An Naisaburi] Ci ha narrato [Ibrahim bin Umar Ash Shan'ani] disse; ho sentito [An Nu'man bin Abu Syaibah] said da [Thawus] da [Ibnu Abbas] da Il Profeta, pace su di lui, disse: "Segala something chi inebriante è khamr, e segala something chi inebriante è haram. Chiunque ha bevuto something chi inebriante poi his preghiera selama quattro puluh mattina non was ha ricevuto, quando he bertaubat poi Allah farà ha dato him taubat. e se on volte the quarto di them he è tornato ha bevuto, poi became diritto over Allah per ha dato him ha bevuto da thinah al khabal." He was ha chiesto, "O Rasulullah, whether thinah al khabal che?" He Answered: "Nanah penghuni Neraka. e Chiunque ha dato ha bevuto khamr figlio piccolo, mentre figlio piccolo non ha saputo halal e its divieto, poi Allah farà ha dato him ha bevuto da thinah al khabal."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Qutaibah] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Isma'il bin Ja'far] dari [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] dari [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] dari [Jabir bin Abdullah] ia berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam bersabda: "Sesuatu yang memabukkan, maka banyak dan sedikitnya adalah haram."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Qutaibah] narrated to us [Isma'il bin Ja'far] from [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] from [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] from [Jabir bin Abdullah] he said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him said: "Something who intoxicating, then many and its small amount is haram."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Qutaibah] 私たちに語った [Isma'il bin Ja'far] から [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] から [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] から [Jabir bin Abdullah] 彼は言った, "アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） said: "Something 誰 酔わせる, それから 多くの そして its 小さな amount である ハラーム."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Qutaibah] 우리에게 전했다 [Isma'il bin Ja'far] 부터 [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] 부터 [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] 부터 [Jabir bin Abdullah] 그는 말했다, "알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) said: "Something 누구 취하게 하는, 그러자 많은 そして its 작은 amount 이다 하람."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Qutaibah] 向我们讲述 [Isma'il bin Ja'far] 从 [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] 从 [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] 从 [Jabir bin Abdullah] 他说, "安拉的使者（愿他平安） said: "Something 谁 使人醉, 然后 多 和 its 小 amount 是 非法."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Qutaibah] Nous a raconté [Isma'il bin Ja'far] de [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] de [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] de [Jabir bin Abdullah] il a dit, "Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui said: "Something qui enivrant, puis beaucoup et its petit amount est haram."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Qutaibah] Hat uns erzählt [Isma'il bin Ja'far] von [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] von [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] von [Jabir bin Abdullah] er sagte, "Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm said: "Something wer berauschend, dann viele und its klein amount ist haram."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Qutaibah] Ci ha narrato [Isma'il bin Ja'far] da [Daud bin Bakr bin Abu Al Furat] da [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] da [Jabir bin Abdullah] disse, "Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui said: "Something chi inebriante, poi molti e its piccolo amount è haram."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْسُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ الْبِتْعِ فَقَالَ كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد قَرَأْتُ عَلَى يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ الْجُرْجُسِيِّ حَدَّثَكُمْ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ زَادَ وَالْبِتْعُ نَبِيذُ الْعَسَلِ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ يَشْرَبُونَهُ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد سَمِعْت أَحْمَدَ بْنَ حَنْبَلٍ يَقُولُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مَا كَانَ أَثْبَتَهُ مَا كَانَ فِيهِمْ مِثْلُهُ يَعْنِي فِي أَهْلِ حِمْصٍ يَعْنِي الْجُرْجُسِيَّ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] dari [Malik] dari [Ibnu Syihab] dari [Abu Salamah] dan [Aisyah] radliallahu 'anha, ia berkata, "Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam ditanya mengenai Al Bit' (minuman yang terbuat dari madu). Kemudian beliau menjawab: "Segala minuman yang memabukkan adalah haram." Abu Daud berkata, "Aku membaca riwayat di hadapan [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] telah menceritakan hadits ini kepada kalian dari [Az Zubaidi] dari [Az Zuhri] dengan sanadnya. Ia menambahkan, "Al Bit' adalah minuman hasil perasan madu, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa meminumnya." Abu Daud berkata, "Aku mendengar Ahmad bin Hanbal berkata, "Tidak ada tuhan yang berhak untuk disembah selain Allah, tidak ada yang lebih teguh daripadanya, tidak ada di antara mereka yang semisal dia, yaitu di antara penduduk Himsh. Dan yang ia maksudkan adalah Al Jurjusi."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] from [Malik] from [Ibnu Syihab] from [Abu Salamah] and [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased with her, he said, "The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him was asked regarding Al Bit' (beverage who made of from honey). Then he answered: "Segala beverage who intoxicating is haram." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat in front [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has narrated hadith this to you all from [Az Zubaidi] from [Az Zuhri] with its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' is beverage hasil juice honey, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa drank it." Abu Daud said, "I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There is no Lord who berhak for disembah selain Allah, there is no who more teguh than it, there is no in between they who semisal he, yaitu in between penduduk Himsh. And who he meant is Al Jurjusi."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] から [Malik] から [Ibnu Syihab] から [Abu Salamah] そして [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased とともに her, 彼は言った, "アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ） was 尋ねた regarding Al Bit' (飲料 誰 作った の から 蜂蜜). それから he answered: "Segala 飲料 誰 酔わせる である ハラーム." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat 〜に 前 [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has 伝えた ハディース この へ あなたがた から [Az Zubaidi] から [Az Zuhri] とともに its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' である 飲料 hasil ジュース 蜂蜜, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa それを飲んだ." Abu Daud said, "私は聞いた Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There である no Lord 誰 berhak 〜のために disembah selain Allah, there である no 誰 より多くの teguh than it, there である no 〜に 〜の間に they 誰 semisal he, yaitu 〜に 〜の間に penduduk Himsh. そして 誰 he meant である Al Jurjusi."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] 부터 [Malik] 부터 [Ibnu Syihab] 부터 [Abu Salamah] そして [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased 함께 her, 그는 말했다, "알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를) was 물었다 regarding Al Bit' (음료 누구 만들었다 의 부터 꿀). 그러자 he answered: "Segala 음료 누구 취하게 하는 이다 하람." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat 에 앞 [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has 전했다 하디스 이 에게 너희들 부터 [Az Zubaidi] 부터 [Az Zuhri] 함께 its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' 이다 음료 hasil 즙 꿀, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa 그것을 마셨다." Abu Daud said, "나는 들었다 Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There 이다 no Lord 누구 berhak 위해 disembah selain Allah, there 이다 no 누구 더 많은 teguh than it, there 이다 no 에 사이에 they 누구 semisal he, yaitu 에 사이에 penduduk Himsh. そして 누구 he meant 이다 Al Jurjusi."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] 从 [Malik] 从 [Ibnu Syihab] 从 [Abu Salamah] 和 [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased 与 her, 他说, "安拉的使者（愿他平安） was 问 regarding Al Bit' (饮料 谁 制作 的 从 蜂蜜). 然后 he answered: "Segala 饮料 谁 使人醉 是 非法." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat 在 前面 [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has 讲述 圣训 这 向 你们 从 [Az Zubaidi] 从 [Az Zuhri] 与 its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' 是 饮料 hasil 果汁 蜂蜜, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa 喝了它." Abu Daud said, "我听到 Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There 是 no Lord 谁 berhak 为 disembah selain Allah, there 是 no 谁 更多 teguh than it, there 是 no 在 之间 they 谁 semisal he, yaitu 在 之间 penduduk Himsh. 和 谁 he meant 是 Al Jurjusi."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] de [Malik] de [Ibnu Syihab] de [Abu Salamah] et [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased avec her, il a dit, "Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui was a demandé regarding Al Bit' (boisson qui a fait de de miel). puis he answered: "Segala boisson qui enivrant est haram." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat dans devant [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has a raconté hadith ce à vous tous de [Az Zubaidi] de [Az Zuhri] avec its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' est boisson hasil jus miel, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa l'a bu." Abu Daud said, "j'ai entendu Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There est no Lord qui berhak pour disembah selain Allah, there est no qui plus teguh than it, there est no dans entre they qui semisal he, yaitu dans entre penduduk Himsh. et qui he meant est Al Jurjusi."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] von [Malik] von [Ibnu Syihab] von [Abu Salamah] und [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased mit her, er sagte, "Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm was fragte regarding Al Bit' (Getränk wer machte von von Honig). dann he answered: "Segala Getränk wer berauschend ist haram." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat in vorn [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has erzählte Hadith dies zu ihr alle von [Az Zubaidi] von [Az Zuhri] mit its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' ist Getränk hasil Saft Honig, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa trank es." Abu Daud said, "ich hörte Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There ist no Lord wer berhak für disembah selain Allah, there ist no wer mehr teguh than it, there ist no in zwischen they wer semisal he, yaitu in zwischen penduduk Himsh. und wer he meant ist Al Jurjusi."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Abdullah bin Maslamah Al Qa'nabi] da [Malik] da [Ibnu Syihab] da [Abu Salamah] e [Aisyah] may Allah be pleased con her, disse, "Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui was ha chiesto regarding Al Bit' (bevanda chi ha fatto di da miele). poi he answered: "Segala bevanda chi inebriante è haram." Abu Daud said, "I membaca riwayat in davanti [Yazid bin Abdu Rabbih Al Jurjusi] [Muhammad bin Harb] has ha narrato hadith questo a voi tutti da [Az Zubaidi] da [Az Zuhri] con its chain. He adding, "Al Bit' è bevanda hasil succo miele, dahulu penduduk Yaman biasa l'ha bevuto." Abu Daud said, "ho sentito Ahmad bin Hanbal said, "There è no Lord chi berhak per disembah selain Allah, there è no chi più teguh than it, there è no in tra they chi semisal he, yaitu in tra penduduk Himsh. e chi he meant è Al Jurjusi."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِىِّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ عَنْ دَيْلَمٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ قَالَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ بَارِدَةٍ نُعَالِجُ فِيهَا عَمَلًا شَدِيدًا وَإِنَّا نَتَّخِذُ شَرَابًا مِنْ هَذَا الْقَمْحِ نَتَقَوَّى بِهِ عَلَى أَعْمَالِنَا وَعَلَى بَرْدِ بِلَادِنَا قَالَ هَلْ يُسْكِرُ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ غَيْرُ تَارِكِيهِ قَالَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَتْرُكُوهُ فَقَاتِلُوهُمْ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Hannad bin As Sari] telah menceritakan kepada kami ['Abdah] dari [Muhammad bin Ishaq] dari [Yazid bin Abu Habib] dari [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] dari [Dailam Al Himyari] ia berkata, "Aku pernah bertanya kepada Rasulullah shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam, "Wahai Rasulullah, sesungguhnya kami berada di negeri yang dingin, di sana kami melakukan pekerjaan berat, dan kami membuat minuman dari gandum ini agar kami kuat untuk melakukan pekerjaan kami dan tahan terhadap dinginnya negeri kami?" Beliau menjawab: "Apakah hal itu memabukkan?" Aku menjawab, "Ya." Beliau bersabda: "Jauhilah minuman tersebut!" Aku katakan, "Orang-orang tidak meninggalkannya." Beliau bersabda: "Apabila mereka tidak meninggalkannya maka perangilah mereka."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Hannad bin As Sari] narrated to us ['Abdah] from [Muhammad bin Ishaq] from [Yazid bin Abu Habib] from [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] from [Dailam Al Himyari] he said, "I ever asked to The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada in land who cold, in sana we performed work heavy, and we made beverage from wheat this so that we strong for performed work we and tahan terhadap dinginnya land we?" He answered: "Whether thing that intoxicating?" I answered, "O." He said: "avoid beverage that!" I say, "Person-person not left it." He said: "When they not left it then perangilah they."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Hannad bin As Sari] 私たちに語った ['Abdah] から [Muhammad bin Ishaq] から [Yazid bin Abu Habib] から [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] から [Dailam Al Himyari] 彼は言った, "I かつて 尋ねた へ アッラーの使徒（彼に平安あれ）, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada 〜に 土地 誰 冷たい, 〜に sana we performed 仕事 重い, そして we 作った 飲料 から 小麦 この 〜するために we 強い 〜のために performed 仕事 we そして tahan terhadap dinginnya 土地 we?" He answered: "Whether thing その 酔わせる?" I answered, "O." 彼は言った: "avoid 飲料 その!" I say, "人-人 〜ない 去った it." 彼は言った: "〜のとき they 〜ない 去った it それから perangilah they."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Hannad bin As Sari] 우리에게 전했다 ['Abdah] 부터 [Muhammad bin Ishaq] 부터 [Yazid bin Abu Habib] 부터 [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] 부터 [Dailam Al Himyari] 그는 말했다, "I 한 번이라도 물었다 에게 알라의 메신저(그에게 평화가 있기를), "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada 에 땅 누구 찬, 에 sana we performed 일 무거운, そして we 만들었다 음료 부터 밀 이 ~하기 위해 we 강한 위해 performed 일 we そして tahan terhadap dinginnya 땅 we?" He answered: "Whether thing 그 취하게 하는?" I answered, "O." 그는 말했다: "avoid 음료 그!" I say, "사람-사람 ~아니다 떠났다 it." 그는 말했다: "~할 때 they ~아니다 떠났다 it 그러자 perangilah they."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Hannad bin As Sari] 向我们讲述 ['Abdah] 从 [Muhammad bin Ishaq] 从 [Yazid bin Abu Habib] 从 [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] 从 [Dailam Al Himyari] 他说, "I 曾经 问 向 安拉的使者（愿他平安）, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada 在 土地 谁 冷, 在 sana we performed 工作 重, 和 we 制作 饮料 从 小麦 这 以便 we 强 为 performed 工作 we 和 tahan terhadap dinginnya 土地 we?" He answered: "Whether thing 那 使人醉?" I answered, "O." 他说: "avoid 饮料 那!" I say, "人-人 不 离开 it." 他说: "当 they 不 离开 it 然后 perangilah they."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Hannad bin As Sari] Nous a raconté ['Abdah] de [Muhammad bin Ishaq] de [Yazid bin Abu Habib] de [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] de [Dailam Al Himyari] il a dit, "I jamais a demandé à Le Messager d'Allah, que la paix soit sur lui, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada dans terre qui froid, dans sana we performed travail lourd, et we a fait boisson de blé ce afin que we fort pour performed travail we et tahan terhadap dinginnya terre we?" He answered: "Whether thing que enivrant?" I answered, "O." il a dit: "avoid boisson que!" I say, "personne-personne pas est parti it." il a dit: "quand they pas est parti it puis perangilah they."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Hannad bin As Sari] Hat uns erzählt ['Abdah] von [Muhammad bin Ishaq] von [Yazid bin Abu Habib] von [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] von [Dailam Al Himyari] er sagte, "I je fragte zu Der Gesandte Allahs, Friede sei mit ihm, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada in Land wer kalt, in sana we performed Arbeit schwer, und we machte Getränk von Weizen dies damit we stark für performed Arbeit we und tahan terhadap dinginnya Land we?" He answered: "Whether thing dass berauschend?" I answered, "O." er sagte: "avoid Getränk dass!" I say, "Person-Person nicht verließ it." er sagte: "wenn they nicht verließ it dann perangilah they."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Hannad bin As Sari] Ci ha narrato ['Abdah] da [Muhammad bin Ishaq] da [Yazid bin Abu Habib] da [Murtsad bin Abdullah Al Yazini] da [Dailam Al Himyari] disse, "I mai ha chiesto a Il Messaggero di Allah, pace su di lui, "O Rasulullah, indeed we berada in terra chi freddo, in sana we performed lavoro pesante, e we ha fatto bevanda da grano questo affinché we forte per performed lavoro we e tahan terhadap dinginnya terra we?" He answered: "Whether thing che inebriante?" I answered, "O." disse: "avoid bevanda che!" I say, "persona-persona non è partito it." disse: "quando they non è partito it poi perangilah they."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى قَالَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ شَرَابٍ مِنْ الْعَسَلِ فَقَالَ ذَاكَ الْبِتْعُ قُلْتُ وَيُنْتَبَذُ مِنْ الشَّعِيرِ وَالذُّرَةِ فَقَالَ ذَلِكَ الْمِزْرُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَخْبِرْ قَوْمَكَ أَنَّ كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] dari [Khalid] dari ['Ashim bin Kulaib] dari [Abu Burdah] dari [Abu Musa] ia berkata, "Aku pernah bertanya kepada Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam mengenai minuman yang terbuat dari madu. Kemudian beliau menjawab: "Itu adalah arak." Aku katakan kepada beliau, "Dia dibuat dari perasan jewawut dan jagung?" Beliau bersabda: "Itu adalah arak." Kemudian beliau bersabda: "Beritahukan kepada kaummu bahwa segala sesuatu yang memabukkan adalah haram."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] from [Khalid] from ['Ashim bin Kulaib] from [Abu Burdah] from [Abu Musa] he said, "I ever asked to The Prophet, peace be upon him regarding beverage who made of from honey. Then he answered: "That is wine." I say to he, "He was made from juice millet and jagung?" He said: "That is wine." Then he said: "Beritahukan to kaummu that segala something who intoxicating is haram."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] から [Khalid] から ['Ashim bin Kulaib] から [Abu Burdah] から [Abu Musa] 彼は言った, "I かつて 尋ねた へ 預言者（彼に平安あれ） regarding 飲料 誰 作った の から 蜂蜜. それから he answered: "その である 酒." I say へ he, "He 作られた から ジュース キビ そして jagung?" 彼は言った: "その である 酒." それから 彼は言った: "Beritahukan へ kaummu その segala something 誰 酔わせる である ハラーム."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] 부터 [Khalid] 부터 ['Ashim bin Kulaib] 부터 [Abu Burdah] 부터 [Abu Musa] 그는 말했다, "I 한 번이라도 물었다 에게 예언자(그에게 평화가 있기를) regarding 음료 누구 만들었다 의 부터 꿀. 그러자 he answered: "그 이다 술." I say 에게 he, "He 만들어졌다 부터 즙 기장 そして jagung?" 그는 말했다: "그 이다 술." 그러자 그는 말했다: "Beritahukan 에게 kaummu 그 segala something 누구 취하게 하는 이다 하람."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] 从 [Khalid] 从 ['Ashim bin Kulaib] 从 [Abu Burdah] 从 [Abu Musa] 他说, "I 曾经 问 向 先知（愿他平安） regarding 饮料 谁 制作 的 从 蜂蜜. 然后 he answered: "那 是 酒." I say 向 he, "He 被制作 从 果汁 小米 和 jagung?" 他说: "那 是 酒." 然后 他说: "Beritahukan 向 kaummu 那 segala something 谁 使人醉 是 非法."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] de [Khalid] de ['Ashim bin Kulaib] de [Abu Burdah] de [Abu Musa] il a dit, "I jamais a demandé à Le Prophète, que la paix soit sur lui regarding boisson qui a fait de de miel. puis he answered: "que est vin." I say à he, "He a été fait de jus millet et jagung?" il a dit: "que est vin." puis il a dit: "Beritahukan à kaummu que segala something qui enivrant est haram."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] von [Khalid] von ['Ashim bin Kulaib] von [Abu Burdah] von [Abu Musa] er sagte, "I je fragte zu Der Prophet, Friede sei mit ihm regarding Getränk wer machte von von Honig. dann he answered: "dass ist Wein." I say zu he, "He wurde gemacht von Saft Hirse und jagung?" er sagte: "dass ist Wein." dann er sagte: "Beritahukan zu kaummu dass segala something wer berauschend ist haram."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Wahb bin Baqiyyah] da [Khalid] da ['Ashim bin Kulaib] da [Abu Burdah] da [Abu Musa] disse, "I mai ha chiesto a Il Profeta, pace su di lui regarding bevanda chi ha fatto di da miele. poi he answered: "che è vino." I say a he, "He è stato fatto da succo miglio e jagung?" disse: "che è vino." poi disse: "Beritahukan a kaummu che segala something chi inebriante è haram."

hadits.arab: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍوأَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى عَنْ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ وَالْكُوبَةِ وَالْغُبَيْرَاءِ وَقَالَ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌقَالَ أَبُو دَاوُد قَالَ ابْنُ سَلَامٍ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَيْرَاءُ السُّكْرُكَةُ تُعْمَلُ مِنْ الذُّرَةِ شَرَابٌ يَعْمَلُهُ الْحَبَشَةُ
hadits.id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Musa bin Isma'il] telah menceritakan kepada kami [Hammad] dari [Muhammad bin Ishaq] dari [Yazid bin Abu Habib] dari [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] dari [Abdullah bin 'Amru] bahwa Nabi shallallahu 'alaihi wasallam melarang khamer, judi, gendang kecil, Al Ghubaira` (jenis minuman yang terbuat dari jagung). Dan beliau bersabda: "Segala yang memabukkan adalah haram." Abu Daud berkata, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid berkata, "Al Ghubaira` adalah sukrukah yang terbuat dari jagung, yaitu minuman yang dibuat oleh orang-orang Habasyah."
hadits.en: Narrated to us [Musa bin Isma'il] narrated to us [Hammad] from [Muhammad bin Ishaq] from [Yazid bin Abu Habib] from [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] from [Abdullah bin 'Amru] that The Prophet, peace be upon him forbade khamr, gambling, gendang small, Al Ghubaira` (jenis beverage who made of from jagung). And he said: "Segala who intoxicating is haram." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` is sukrukah who made of from jagung, yaitu beverage who was made by person-person Habasyah."
hadits.ja: 私たちに語った [Musa bin Isma'il] 私たちに語った [Hammad] から [Muhammad bin Ishaq] から [Yazid bin Abu Habib] から [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] から [Abdullah bin 'Amru] その 預言者（彼に平安あれ） 禁じた ハムル, gambling, gendang 小さな, Al Ghubaira` (jenis 飲料 誰 作った の から jagung). そして 彼は言った: "Segala 誰 酔わせる である ハラーム." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` である sukrukah 誰 作った の から jagung, yaitu 飲料 誰 作られた by 人-人 Habasyah."
hadits.ko: 우리에게 전했다 [Musa bin Isma'il] 우리에게 전했다 [Hammad] 부터 [Muhammad bin Ishaq] 부터 [Yazid bin Abu Habib] 부터 [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] 부터 [Abdullah bin 'Amru] 그 예언자(그에게 평화가 있기를) 금지했다 함르, gambling, gendang 작은, Al Ghubaira` (jenis 음료 누구 만들었다 의 부터 jagung). そして 그는 말했다: "Segala 누구 취하게 하는 이다 하람." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` 이다 sukrukah 누구 만들었다 의 부터 jagung, yaitu 음료 누구 만들어졌다 by 사람-사람 Habasyah."
hadits.zh: 向我们讲述 [Musa bin Isma'il] 向我们讲述 [Hammad] 从 [Muhammad bin Ishaq] 从 [Yazid bin Abu Habib] 从 [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] 从 [Abdullah bin 'Amru] 那 先知（愿他平安） 禁止 哈姆尔酒, gambling, gendang 小, Al Ghubaira` (jenis 饮料 谁 制作 的 从 jagung). 和 他说: "Segala 谁 使人醉 是 非法." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` 是 sukrukah 谁 制作 的 从 jagung, yaitu 饮料 谁 被制作 by 人-人 Habasyah."
hadits.fr: Nous a raconté [Musa bin Isma'il] Nous a raconté [Hammad] de [Muhammad bin Ishaq] de [Yazid bin Abu Habib] de [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] de [Abdullah bin 'Amru] que Le Prophète, que la paix soit sur lui a interdit khamr, gambling, gendang petit, Al Ghubaira` (jenis boisson qui a fait de de jagung). et il a dit: "Segala qui enivrant est haram." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` est sukrukah qui a fait de de jagung, yaitu boisson qui a été fait by personne-personne Habasyah."
hadits.de: Hat uns erzählt [Musa bin Isma'il] Hat uns erzählt [Hammad] von [Muhammad bin Ishaq] von [Yazid bin Abu Habib] von [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] von [Abdullah bin 'Amru] dass Der Prophet, Friede sei mit ihm verbot Khamr, gambling, gendang klein, Al Ghubaira` (jenis Getränk wer machte von von jagung). und er sagte: "Segala wer berauschend ist haram." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` ist sukrukah wer machte von von jagung, yaitu Getränk wer wurde gemacht by Person-Person Habasyah."
hadits.it: Ci ha narrato [Musa bin Isma'il] Ci ha narrato [Hammad] da [Muhammad bin Ishaq] da [Yazid bin Abu Habib] da [Al Walid bin 'Abdah] da [Abdullah bin 'Amru] che Il Profeta, pace su di lui ha proibito khamr, gambling, gendang piccolo, Al Ghubaira` (jenis bevanda chi ha fatto di da jagung). e disse: "Segala chi inebriante è haram." Abu Daud said, "Ibnu Salam Abu 'Ubaid said, "Al Ghubaira` è sukrukah chi ha fatto di da jagung, yaitu bevanda chi è stato fatto by persona-persona Habasyah."
